members.name: Mike Rogers

votes.summary: The House voted 204-2 to reject a motion to repeal the Authorization for Use of Military Force Against Iraq Resolution of 2002.
House voted to repeal the Authorization for Use of Military Force Against Iraq Resolution of 2002.
Passed the Iron Dome Supplemental Appropriations Act, 2022, appropriating $1 billion to Israel for procurement of the Iron Dome missile defense system.
The House passed a bill prohibiting the importation of Russian energy products, imposing a trade embargo on Russia.

The House passed the motion to suspend rules and pass the Suspending Normal Trade Relations with Russia and Belarus Act, which imposed visa- and property-blocking sanctions on Russia and Belarus and suspended normal trade relations.
This bill suspends normal trade relations with Russia and Belarus and authorizes the President to increase tariffs on their products in response to the invasion of Ukraine.

The House passed the Stop Iranian Drones Act, expanding existing sanctions on Iran by adding unmanned combat aerial vehicles to the list of weapons subject to sanctions and requiring reporting on entities attacking U.S. citizens.
Passed the Additional Ukraine Supplemental Appropriations Act, 2022, providing additional funding for military and humanitarian assistance to Ukraine.
The House passed the Russia and Belarus Financial Sanctions Act, requiring U.S. financial institutions to enforce financial sanctions against Russia and Belarus.

Passed the Isolate Russian Government Officials Act of 2022, requiring Treasury, SEC, and Federal Reserve to exclude Russian government officials from international meetings including G20, Basel Committee, and BIS until five years after enactment or 30 days after the President reports Russia has ceased destabilizing Ukraine.

members.bottom_line: Does not count: no anti-interventionist vote on aid to Israel (sanctions: inconsistent (4 of 28 anti); use of force abroad: inconsistent (11 of 38 anti)) by this point. (Rule-based from Voteview roll calls.)

Passed the Iron Dome Supplemental Appropriations Act, 2022, appropriating $1 billion to Israel for procurement of the Iron Dome missile defense system.
The House passed a bill prohibiting the importation of Russian energy products, imposing a trade embargo on Russia.

The House passed the motion to suspend rules and pass the Suspending Normal Trade Relations with Russia and Belarus Act, which imposed visa- and property-blocking sanctions on Russia and Belarus and suspended normal trade relations.
This bill suspends normal trade relations with Russia and Belarus and authorizes the President to increase tariffs on their products in response to the invasion of Ukraine.

The House passed the Stop Iranian Drones Act, expanding existing sanctions on Iran by adding unmanned combat aerial vehicles to the list of weapons subject to sanctions and requiring reporting on entities attacking U.S. citizens.
Passed the Additional Ukraine Supplemental Appropriations Act, 2022, providing additional funding for military and humanitarian assistance to Ukraine.
The House passed the Russia and Belarus Financial Sanctions Act, requiring U.S. financial institutions to enforce financial sanctions against Russia and Belarus.

Passed the Isolate Russian Government Officials Act of 2022, requiring Treasury, SEC, and Federal Reserve to exclude Russian government officials from international meetings including G20, Basel Committee, and BIS until five years after enactment or 30 days after the President reports Russia has ceased destabilizing Ukraine.

members.bottom_line: Does not count: no anti-interventionist vote on aid to Israel (military aid to other countries: turning (1 of 5 anti); use of force abroad: became consistent (5 of 11 anti); war authorizations: inconsistent (2 of 3 anti)) by this point. (Rule-based from Voteview roll calls.)
